down.title: The app is not responding
down.body: It is not answering: its window may have been closed or it may have stopped. Open it again with its shortcut and reload this page.

broken.title: This page has failed
broken.body: It is a bug in the app, not a problem with your data: the other pages still work.
broken.report: If it keeps happening, report it on <issues>GitHub</issues> with what you were doing. The error details are in the browser console: press <kbd>F12</kbd> and open “Console”.

reminders.running: Your agent is working in the background

demo.label: Demo mode
demo.title: Demo mode: fictitious data.
demo.body: People, companies and jobs are made up; your real data is not touched.

running.title: Searching for jobs…
running.body: Your agent is still working in its window.
running.companies: The app is checking your companies' careers sites.

stale.title: No news from your agent
stale.body: It has not added anything for a while. Check its window: it may be waiting for you, or it may have closed.

no_browser.title: Your agent could not search
no_browser.body: It cannot reach your browser. Connect it as “Before you start” explains and launch the search again.

stopped.title: Your agent stopped before the end
stopped.body: Its window says why. What it had already found is in the Inbox.

searchRun.problems_one: {{count}} problem on the job boards or companies. See it in “Where to search”.
searchRun.problems_other: {{count}} problems on the job boards or companies. See them in “Where to search”.

tasks.runningTerminal: Still going in your agent's window. If it asks for permission, answer there.
tasks.runningBackground: No window: progress is shown here.
tasks.stale: No news for 30 minutes. Check your agent's window or close this notice.

stopped.title: Your agent has stopped
stopped.body: It has not finished everything. Check its window to see why.

needs_user.title: Your agent needs to know something
needs_user.body: It stopped with a question for you.

process-jobs.running: Reading and assessing the new jobs…

tasks.stopConfirm: Stop it? What your agent has already saved stays.
tasks.stopFailed: It could not be stopped. Try again.
tasks.stoppingBody: Stopping your agent. It takes a few seconds.

cancelled.title: Stopped
cancelled.body: You stopped it. What your agent had already saved stays.

tasks.terminalStop: To stop it, close your agent's window.

tools.check_job_open: Checking whether the job is still open
tools.save_cv_content: Saving the CV and generating the PDF

panel.waiting: Queued: the agent starts in a few seconds.
panel.empty: This run did not save its conversation.
panel.noPermissions: This agent does not ask the portal for permission: whatever is not allowed in this action is denied without asking.

compose.label: Message for the agent
compose.placeholderResume: Ask for a change or continue…
compose.hintLive: It is passed on at its next step.
compose.hintResume: It continues the same conversation: it does not start from scratch.
compose.windowOnly: This agent does not continue the conversation without a window: it is followed in a window, in the same session.

tasks.waitingQuestion: The agent is waiting for an answer.
tasks.waitingPermission: The agent is asking for permission to continue.

prompt.label: Answer for the agent
prompt.expires: It continues without an answer in {{time}}.
prompt.skipped: No answer: it continues without it.

answers.always: Always allowed in this project (removed on the “Agent” page).
